dialogues.speaker: Urwa
dialogues.text: That's right. Well, it's mostly about the flow and exchange of goods. Bringing Sumeru's specialties here, and sending Nod-Krai's wares back to Sumeru... Mutual benefit is always a welcome thing.

dialogues.speaker: Urwa
dialogues.text: As long as we can make Mora for Lord Sangemah Bay, and keep the back and forth journeys safe, I'm satisfied. Phew... "safe" is quite rare in these parts, after all.
